SMTO-POL-0025 — This request tried to switch off a rule that is always on

GUID: 074332fe-9edd-4a89-abe4-8cbdd4e61057
Slug: verified-context-reuse-required
Domain: POL · Subsystem: pol

What happened

  • The request came with behavior settings that try to stop SMTO reusing information it has already checked in this task. That rule can't be switched off at any effort level, so SMTO didn't accept the request.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In the message box, pick a level from the Behavior effort list (Low to Ultra) and send your request again. The built-in effort levels always keep this rule on, so SMTO accepts them.
  2. If the request came from a script or another program that sends work to SMTO, ask whoever maintains it to remove the setting that turns off reuse of checked information. SMTO only accepts behavior settings that keep this rule switched on.

What success looks like

  • SMTO accepts the request and the task starts.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't resend the same behavior settings; they'll be refused every time.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Behavior-policy validation rejected the supplied policy because reuse_verified_context was not literally true; verified current-context reuse is required at every effort level.

What this means

  • Behavior-policy validation requires verified current-context reuse to remain true at every effort level. Policy and approval decisions are scoped to their owning operation. Existing receipts determine prior effects; this explanation neither grants authority nor changes retry ownership.

Why this can happen

  • Behavior-policy validation requires verified current-context reuse to remain true at every effort level.

How to diagnose it

  • Check the submitted behavior-policy override for a false exact-reuse value; distinguish this invariant from adjustable effort settings.

How to fix it

  • Remove the reuse_verified_context override (or set it to true) in the submitted native_behavior_policy, or submit only behavior_effort and let the server resolve the preset (behavior_policy.py AgentBehaviorPolicy and resolve_behavior_policy).
  • Remove the unsupported false override. Use the supported behavior policy format; changing effort does not disable verified current-context reuse.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The behavior policy validates with verified current-context reuse enabled.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Policy and approval decisions are scoped to their owning operation. Existing receipts determine prior effects; this explanation neither grants authority nor changes retry ownership.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
